lessons.claim: Even if the fastest mode is not overdamped (τ_p/τ_fast = 0.60, a damping ratio ζ=0.65<1), if that mode is far enough from the observation band the BD observables are unaffected -- in chain-bend the measured difference is at most 0.159% across the whole De range and increases monotonically with De. The physical reason: for ω ≪ 1/τ_fast the fastest mode follows quasi-statically, so it contributes its static compliance and not its **dynamics**. ★ But this test looks only at the inertial term itself -- it does not cover thermal ringing × nonlinear coupling (in chain-bend max|θ|=2.8e-3 rad so it looks small, but it was not confirmed).

not_verified: the thermal-ringing × nonlinear-coupling route is unconfirmed
